name: PricePulse
description: React/Vite price analysis app with an Express/Vercel products API, PostgreSQL storage and scheduled Danawa collection. The files map is a partial source snapshot, not a standalone app generator; use the full repository to run the application.

    "refresh:live": "tsx server/scripts/refreshLivePrices.ts",
    "start": "NODE_ENV=production node dist/index.js",
    "preview": "vite preview --host",
